parallax-studio-concept.webp.label: Concept preview
parallax-studio-concept.webp.source: Generated from the product's video-generation controls and existing palette.
parallax-studio-concept.webp.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: landscape portfolio product preview, 3:2 aspect ratio, crisp high-resolution flat screenshot.
Create a polished, believable concept screen for "Parallax Studio", an AI video creation workspace. Straight-on orthographic UI only, no device, no browser chrome, no perspective, no outer background margins. The entire image is a dark web application interface. Use charcoal navy #111827, panel #1C1D2E, thin #2E304A rules, muted gray labels, soft white sans-serif text, restrained coral #FF6B5A primary action and sage #A8C5A0 ready status.
Layout: compact 64px top bar with small understated P mark and "Parallax Studio" left, "Workspace" active and "Projects" beside it. Below, a large "Create a video" title. A narrow left settings column (one third width) and large right output panel (two thirds width). Left: "PROMPT" field containing "Slow aerial drift over a rugged Pacific coastline, soft morning light, gentle ocean swell." Below small clean selectors labeled "Aspect ratio" value "16:9", "Duration" value "5 seconds", "Quality" value "Standard", "Model" value "Wan 2.2". A coral "Generate video" button. Right: stunning photorealistic cinematic still of a rocky Pacific coastline and teal ocean in soft sunrise, with dark green evergreen trees at cliff edge; use this video frame as the dominant 60% visual of the entire composition. Beneath image a minimal video player with play triangle and "00:00 / 00:05", a fine timeline scrubber, and a discreet green dot "Ready". Bottom of output card a "Coastal morning" title and a small outlined "Download MP4" button. A bottom strip "Recent generations" with three small beautiful coastal cinematic thumbnails in matching light, no extra paragraphs.
Style: thoughtfully crafted working creative tool, dense enough to be real, refined alignments, 8px corner radii, clear legible typography, balanced breathing room, no excessive floating cards or glows.
Do not add business statistics, testimonials, user names, third-party logos, watermarks, or disclaimer text. The surrounding portfolio will label this image Concept preview.

earbud-concept.webp.label: Concept preview
earbud-concept.webp.source: Generated from the native plugin's metering and calibration controls, using illustrative demo values.
earbud-concept.webp.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: landscape portfolio product preview, 3:2 aspect ratio, crisp flat interface image.
Create a credible concept interface for "EARBUD", a native audio metering plugin for monitoring calibrated sound levels and listening exposure. Entire image is a straight-on dark desktop plugin UI, cropped flush to its bounds. No device, browser, perspective, outer scenic background or marketing headline. No waveform art: use actual instrument meters and controls.
Visual design inspired by restrained professional audio software: matte dark charcoal #1e1e2e, panel #252536, fine dividers #39394b, crisp off-white sans-serif type, muted gray mono micro-labels. Restrained warm sage-green meter bars and amber peak marks. Avoid neon RGB gaming styling and glossy knobs.
Layout: top slim header "EARBUD" in widely spaced semibold white, subtitle "Listening exposure meter", right small "DEMO SESSION" label. Generous central monitoring area: left third a large vertical segmented SPL meter with a clear dBA scale, illuminated sage bars reaching roughly78, subtle amber threshold mark at85. Center/right a very large "78.4" followed by "dBA", under it small two-column readings "PEAK" "82.1 dBA" and "LEQ" "76.8 dBA". Lower horizontal section label "SESSION EXPOSURE", a thin sage progress meter with value "12%" at right, beneath "Session  00:42:18". Bottom separated control panel has a "Calibration" section, a small green status dot "Calibrated", an outlined "Recalibrate" button, then "Auto-mute" with an OFF toggle and "Threshold" with value "85 dBA" beside a simple slider, and an understated "Reset session" button.
Make typography large and simple, every section aligned, metric clearly dominant. Premium real instrument-panel craftsmanship with subtle tactile panel borders but no 3D embellishment. No claims about safety or hearing health; all data represents a fictional demo. Do not add app logos other than EARBUD, or watermarks/disclaimer paragraphs. The surrounding portfolio will label this image Concept preview.
